extraction.name: PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite TIme-Series)
extraction.description: The first open-access dataset for training and evaluating panoptic segmentation models on Satellite Image Time Series (SITS), with over 2 billion annotated pixels covering over 4000 km2.
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot, Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was obtained from the open-access Sentinel-2 platform for multi-spectral images and the publicly available French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS) for parcel extents and crop types as reported by farmers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The time between acquisitions is uneven with a median of 5 days due to automatic filtering of acquisitions with extensive cloud cover by the satellite data provider THEIA. Some patches are still partially or completely obstructed by cloud cover.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-spectral images from the open-access Sentinel-2 platform and annotations from the French Land Parcel Identification System (FLPIS).
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: No imputation or further pre-processing/cloud detection was applied; the raw data is produced as is to encourage methods that can favorably address this technical challenge.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Parcels' extents are cropped along the extent of their 128x128 patch, and bounding boxes are modified accordingly. Parcels whose surface is more than 50% outside of the patch are annotated with the void label.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The 10 channels correspond to the non-atmospheric spectral bands of the Sentinel-2 satellite, after atmospheric correction and re-sampling at a spatial resolution of 10 meters per pixel.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each pixel is associated with a semantic label from a nomenclature of 18 crop types plus a background class. Each non-background pixel also has a unique instance label corresponding to its parcel index. Annotations are taken from the French Land Parcel Identification System, as reported by farmers.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The French Payment Agency estimates the accuracy of the crop annotations via in situ control over 98% and the relative error in terms of surfaces under 0.3%.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Farmers in France (reporting to the French Land Parcel Identification System)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Automated analysis of SITS has major economic and environmental implications, such as fair allocation of agricultural subsidies, ensuring best crop rotation practices, and surveying urban development and deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is highly unbalanced, with a ratio of over 50 between the most and least common classes.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The combination of ambiguous borders and hard-to-classify parcel content makes for a challenging panoptic segmentation problem. Thin or visually fragmented parcels are not always recovered correctly.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, evaluating, and cross-validating panoptic and semantic segmentation models on Satellite Image Time Series (SITS).
